source.indices: Satellite index for this block, from the latest usable scene.
source.block: What this block is — its growth stage and its soil.
source.weather: Raw weather for the farm: latest reading, a forecast window, or a derived daily row.
source.weather_index: A curated weather index, with a built-in comparison against the farm's own climatology.
source.weather_risk: Modelled disease or pest pressure for this block.
source.signals: Your own recorded observations, from your signal catalog.
source.grid: Where inside the block the anomaly is, and how bad the worst patch is.
source.crop_attribute: Per-crop data recorded on the block's crop assignment.
source.params: A named threshold this tree declares, so it can be re-tuned without editing the logic.

indexCode.ndvi: Canopy greenness and vigour. Saturates on dense canopy and is noisy over bare soil.
indexCode.ndwi: Surface water — ponding and flooding. Not canopy moisture; that is NDMI.
indexCode.evi: Greenness that resists saturation and soil/haze effects. Better on mature orchards.
indexCode.savi: Greenness corrected for bright bare soil. For young or wide-spaced plantings.
indexCode.ndre: Red-edge chlorophyll and nitrogen status. Still discriminates in dense canopy.
indexCode.gndvi: Green-band greenness; more sensitive to chlorophyll than NDVI.
indexCode.ndmi: Leaf and canopy water content. Falls as the canopy dries — the water-stress index.
indexCode.bsi: Bare ground between plants. Rises as canopy is lost — reads planting gaps and plant loss rather than greenness.
indexCode.msi: Canopy moisture stress, SWIR/NIR. Inverted: higher means drier. Same signal as NDMI on an unbounded scale.
indexCode.msavi: Vigour with the soil background corrected out, the correction adapting to how much canopy is there. Prefer it over SAVI for rules that fire while cover is still partial.
indexCode.lst: Land surface temperature in °C — a physical temperature, not a ratio, so thresholds are absolute degrees. Landsat: one pass every 16 days at 100 m, coarser and less frequent than the spectral indices.
indexCode.cwsi: Crop water stress, 0 (freely transpiring) to 1 (stomata closed), from canopy-minus-air temperature. Rises with stress — the opposite direction to the greenness indices. Uncalibrated for local crops, so read it as a relative signal over time.
indexCode.smi: Soil moisture from the temperature-greenness relationship, 0 (dry) to 1 (wet). Needs a spread of greenness across the block; a uniform canopy falls back to a plain temperature reading.

indicesKey.mean: The block's average on the latest scene. Absolute, so thresholds are crop-specific.
indicesKey.baseline_deviation: Standard deviations from this block's own value for this day of year. Self-calibrating.
indicesKey.slope: Rate of change over recent history, index units per day. Negative means declining.
indicesKey.delta: Total change across the recent window — the size of the move, not its rate.
indicesKey.trend_direction: The trend as a word: rising, falling or stable.

blockField.growth_stage: The block's current phenological stage, advanced daily from the crop's stage calendar.
blockField.soil_texture: The block's soil texture, from the block record.
blockField.salinity_class: The block's salinity banding, from the block record.

weatherScope.latest_observation: The most recent hourly reading — conditions right now.
weatherScope.forecast_24h: The next 24 hours of forecast, aggregated into one row.
weatherScope.forecast_72h: The next 72 hours of forecast, aggregated into one row.
weatherScope.derived_today: Today's computed daily row: degree days, rolling rain, temperature extremes.
weatherScope.derived_yesterday: Yesterday's daily row — the last complete day the crop actually experienced.

weatherIndexKey.value: The index's actual value for the day, in its own unit.
weatherIndexKey.baseline_deviation: Standard deviations from this farm's climatology for this day of year.

riskCode.powdery_mildew: Mango. Builds on warm, humid but dry days — rain suppresses it. Worst at flowering.
riskCode.anthracnose: Mango. Needs warmth and prolonged leaf wetness. Builds through fruit development.
riskCode.fruit_fly: Mango. Humidity-weighted degree days above 13 °C, concentrated in the fruiting window.

riskField.level: The score banded: low (under 40), moderate (40–69), high (70 and above).

signalKey.value_numeric: The measured number, for a numeric signal.
signalKey.value_categorical: The recorded option, for a categorical signal.
signalKey.value_slope: Rate of change over the last 30 days. Numeric signals only.
signalKey.value_delta: Total change over the last 30 days. Numeric signals only.
signalKey.value_trend_direction: Rising, falling or stable over the last 30 days. Numeric signals only.

gridField.worst_z: How far below the block mean the worst cell sits, in standard deviations.
gridField.flagged_count: How many cells crossed the threshold — the extent, not the depth.
gridField.worst_row: Grid row of the worst cell.
gridField.worst_col: Grid column of the worst cell.
gridField.severity: The verdict for the block: warning or critical.

cropAttributeKey.value: The recorded value. Its type follows the crop field's own definition.

weatherField.humidity_pct: Relative humidity, %. Sustained highs drive fungal infection.
weatherField.wind_direction_deg: Wind direction, degrees clockwise from north.
weatherField.et0_mm: Reference evapotranspiration for that hour, mm.
weatherField.precipitation_mm_total: Total forecast rainfall across the window, mm.
weatherField.precipitation_probability_pct_max: Highest hourly chance of rain in the window, %.
weatherField.air_temp_c_min: Lowest forecast temperature, °C — frost and chill checks.
weatherField.air_temp_c_mean: Average forecast temperature across the window, °C.
weatherField.et0_mm_total: Total forecast water demand across the window, mm.
weatherField.wind_speed_m_s_max: Peak forecast wind, m/s — the spray-safety gate.
weatherField.hours_observed: How many hours of forecast the window actually contains.
weatherField.gdd_base10: Growing degree days for the day, base 10 °C.
weatherField.gdd_base15: Growing degree days for the day, base 15 °C.
weatherField.et0_mm_daily: The day's total reference evapotranspiration, mm.

waterBalanceField.balance_mm: Rain plus irrigation minus what the crop used, in mm. Negative means the block ran a deficit that day.
waterBalanceField.etc_mm: What the crop actually transpired (ET₀ × Kc), in mm. Higher than ET₀ for a crop at peak canopy.
waterBalanceField.et0_mm: Reference demand over standard grass, in mm — the climatic driver before the crop coefficient is applied.
waterBalanceField.kc_used: The crop coefficient used that day. Resolves from the crop's growth stage; falls back to a generic 0.85 when the stage is unknown.
waterBalanceField.precip_mm: Rainfall that landed on the block, in mm.
waterBalanceField.irrigation_mm: Water recorded as applied, in mm. Zero when nothing was logged — check irrigation_logged before reading a zero as 'none applied'.
waterBalanceField.irrigation_logged: Whether any irrigation was actually recorded. Gate on this before acting on a deficit: a farm that never logs irrigation shows a permanent shortfall that is missing bookkeeping, not dry soil.
